coordinateConvention: Origin top-left; X right; Y down; zero-based integer pixel indices. Pixel (x,y) covers [x,x+1)×[y,y+1). Polygon vertices are boundary-pixel indices (pixel centres). Masks are stored as COCO compressed RLE (column-major) relative to 'bounds' [x, y, width, height].
rasterizationRule: Components largest-first; outer ring scan-filled and boundary set (8-connected); each hole filled with 0 then its boundary pixels set to 1. The mask, not the polygon, is authoritative.
